# --- Helpers ---

def log_msg(level, msg):
    ts = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S +0000")
    print(f"{ts} [{level}] {msg}", flush=True)

def format_relative_time(mtime):
    now = time.time()
    diff = max(0, int(now - mtime))
    if diff < 60:
        return "now"
    elif diff < 120:
        return "a minute ago"
    elif diff < 3600:
        return f"{diff // 60} minutes ago"
    elif diff < 7200:
        return "an hour ago"
    elif diff < 86400:
        return f"{diff // 3600} hours ago"
    elif diff < 172800:
        return "a day ago"
    elif diff < 2592000:
        return f"{diff // 86400} days ago"
    elif diff < 5184000:
        return "a month ago"
    elif diff < 31536000:
        return f"{diff // 2592000} months ago"
    elif diff < 63072000:
        return "a year ago"
    else:
        return f"{diff // 31536000} years ago"

def format_iso_time(mtime):
    dt = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime, tz=datetime.timezone.utc)
    return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S +00:00")

def format_size(size_bytes, mode="human"):
    if mode == "exact":
        return f"{size_bytes} B"
    if size_bytes < 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes} B"
    elif size_bytes < 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes / 1024:.1f} KiB"
    elif size_bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes / (1024 * 1024):.1f} MiB"
    elif size_bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024):.1f} GiB"
    else:
        return f"{size_bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024):.1f} TiB"

def html_escape(s):
    return s.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">").replace('"', """)

def parse_inline_markdown(text):
    text = html_escape(text)
    text = re.sub(r'\\*\\*(.*?)\\*\\*', r'<strong>\\1</strong>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\\*(.*?)\\*', r'<em>\\1</em>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'`(.*?)`', r'<code>\\1</code>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\\[(.*?)\\]\\((.*?)\\)', r'<a href="\\2">\\1</a>', text)
    return text

def markdown_to_html(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    html_lines = []
    in_code_block = False
    in_list = False
    in_blockquote = False

    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith("```"):
            if in_code_block:
                html_lines.append("code></code></pre>")
                in_code_block = False
            else:
                if in_list:
                    html_lines.append("</ul>")
                    in_list = False
                if in_blockquote:
                    html_lines.append("</blockquote>")
                    in_blockquote = False
                html_lines.append("<pre><code>")
                in_code_block = True
            continue

        if in_code_block:
            html_lines.append(html_escape(line))
            continue

        if line.startswith("- ") or line.startswith("* "):
            if not in_list:
                html_lines.append("<ul>")
                in_list = True
            item = parse_inline_markdown(line[2:])
            html_lines.append(f"<li>{item}</li>")
            continue
        elif in_list:
            html_lines.append("</ul>")
            in_list = False

        if line.startswith("> "):
            if not in_blockquote:
                html_lines.append("<blockquote>")
                in_blockquote = True
            bq = parse_inline_markdown(line[2:])
            html_lines.append(f"<p>{bq}</p>")
            continue
        elif in_blockquote:
            html_lines.append("</blockquote>")
            in_blockquote = False

        if not line.strip():
            continue

        if line.startswith("# "):
            html_lines.append(f"<h1>{parse_inline_markdown(line[2:])}</h1>")
        elif line.startswith("## "):
            html_lines.append(f"<h2>{parse_inline_markdown(line[3:])}</h2>")
        elif line.startswith("### "):
            html_lines.append(f"<h3>{parse_inline_markdown(line[4:])}</h3>")
        elif line.startswith("#### "):
            html_lines.append(f"<h4>{parse_inline_markdown(line[5:])}</h4>")
        else:
            html_lines.append(f"<p>{parse_inline_markdown(line)}</p>")

    if in_code_block:
        html_lines.append("</code></pre>")
    if in_list:
        html_lines.append("</ul>")
    if in_blockquote:
        html_lines.append("</blockquote>")

    return "\\n".join(html_lines) + "\\n"

def parse_auth_config(auth_list, auth_file):
    credentials = []
    if auth_list:
        for a in auth_list:
            if a:
                credentials.append(a)
    if auth_file and os.path.exists(auth_file):
        with open(auth_file, "r") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line and not line.startswith("#"):
                    credentials.append(line)
    return credentials

def check_auth(auth_header, credentials):
    if not credentials:
        return True
    if not auth_header or not auth_header.startswith("Basic "):
        return False
    try:
        decoded = base64.b64decode(auth_header[6:]).decode("utf-8")
        parts = decoded.split(":", 1)
        user = parts[0]
        passwd = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    except Exception:
        return False

    for cred in credentials:
        c_parts = cred.split(":", 1)
        c_user = c_parts[0]
        c_val = c_parts[1] if len(c_parts) > 1 else ""

        if user != c_user:
            continue

        if c_val.startswith("sha256:"):
            target_hash = c_val[7:]
            if hashlib.sha256(passwd.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == target_hash:
                return True
        elif c_val.startswith("sha512:"):
            target_hash = c_val[7:]
            if hashlib.sha512(passwd.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == target_hash:
                return True
        else:
            if passwd == c_val:
                return True

    return False

def calc_dir_size(dir_path):
    total = 0
    try:
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dir_path):
            for f in files:
                fp = os.path.join(root, f)
                if not os.path.islink(fp):
                    total += os.path.getsize(fp)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return total

def parse_multipart(body, boundary_bytes):
    parts = body.split(b"--" + boundary_bytes)
    fields = []
    for part in parts:
        if not part or part == b"--\\r\\n" or part == b"--":
            continue
        if part.startswith(b"\\r\\n"):
            part = part[2:]
        if part.endswith(b"\\r\\n"):
            part = part[:-2]

        if b"\\r\\n\\r\\n" not in part:
            continue

        header_bytes, payload = part.split(b"\\r\\n\\r\\n", 1)
        headers = {}
        for h_line in header_bytes.decode("latin1", errors="replace").split("\\r\\n"):
            if ":" in h_line:
                k, v = h_line.split(":", 1)
                headers[k.strip().lower()] = v.strip()

        cd = headers.get("content-disposition", "")
        name = None
        filename = None

        m_name = re.search(r'name="([^"]+)"', cd)
        if m_name:
            name = m_name.group(1)
        m_filename = re.search(r'filename="([^"]+)"', cd)
        if m_filename:
            filename = m_filename.group(1)

        fields.append({
            "name": name,
            "filename": filename,
            "headers": headers,
            "payload": payload
        })
    return fields

# --- Server Handler ---

class ThreadingHTTPServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True

class MiniserveHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    server_version = ""
    sys_version = ""

    def version_string(self):
        return ""

    def send_response(self, code, message=None):
        self.log_request(code)
        self.send_response_only(code, message)
        self.send_header("Date", self.date_time_string())

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        pass

    def send_custom_headers(self):
        cfg = self.server.config
        if cfg.header:
            for h in cfg.header:
                if ":" in h:
                    k, v = h.split(":", 1)
                    self.send_header(k.strip(), v.strip())

    def check_auth_or_401(self):
        cfg = self.server.config
        if not cfg.credentials:
            return True
        auth_hdr = self.headers.get("Authorization")
        if check_auth(auth_hdr, cfg.credentials):
            return True
        self.send_response(401)
        self.send_header("www-authenticate", "Basic")
        self.send_header("content-length", "0")
        self.send_custom_headers()
        self.end_headers()
        return False

    def send_error_404(self, route_name):
        cfg = self.server.config
        prefix = cfg.route_prefix
        
        if cfg.disable_indexing:
            body_inner = f'<div class="error"><p>404 Not Found</p><p>File not found.</p><p class="footer"><div class="version"><a href="https://github.com/svenstaro/miniserve">miniserve</a>/{VERSION}</div></p></div>'
        else:
            body_inner = f'<div class="error"><p>404 Not Found</p><p>Route {html_escape(route_name)} could not be found</p><div class="error-nav"><a class="error-back" href="{prefix}/">Go back to file listing</a></div><p class="footer"><div class="version"><a href="https://github.com/svenstaro/miniserve">miniserve</a>/{VERSION}</div></p></div>'

        head_js = HEAD_JS_TEMPLATE.replace("PREFIX", prefix)
        html = f'<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><meta name="color-scheme" content="dark light"><link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="{prefix}/__miniserve_internal/favicon.svg"><link rel="stylesheet" href="{prefix}/__miniserve_internal/style.css"><title>404 Not Found</title>{head_js}</head><body>{body_inner}</body></html>'

        encoded = html.encode("utf-8")
        log_msg("ERROR", f"Route {route_name} could not be found")
        self.send_response(404)
        self.send_header("content-type", "text/html")
        self.send_header("content-length", str(len(encoded)))
        self.send_custom_headers()
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(encoded)

    def do_GET(self):
        self.handle_request_get_head(is_head=False)

    def do_HEAD(self):
        self.handle_request_get_head(is_head=True)

    def handle_request_get_head(self, is_head=False):
        cfg = self.server.config
        prefix = cfg.route_prefix
        parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        req_path = urllib.parse.unquote(parsed_url.path)
        query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)

        if prefix:
            if not (req_path == prefix or req_path.startswith(prefix + "/")):
                self.send_error_404(req_path)
                return
            rel_req_path = req_path[len(prefix):]
            if not rel_req_path:
                rel_req_path = "/"
        else:
            rel_req_path = req_path

        if rel_req_path == "/__miniserve_internal/favicon.svg":
            encoded = FAVICON_SVG.encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("content-type", "image/svg+xml")
            self.send_header("content-length", str(len(encoded)))
            self.send_custom_headers()
            self.end_headers()
            if not is_head:
                self.wfile.write(encoded)
            return

        if rel_req_path == "/__miniserve_internal/style.css":
            encoded = STYLE_CSS.encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("content-type", "text/css")
            self.send_header("content-length", str(len(encoded)))
            self.send_custom_headers()
            self.end_headers()
            if not is_head:
                self.wfile.write(encoded)
            return

        if not self.check_auth_or_401():
            return

        if cfg.is_single_file:
            if rel_req_path != "/" and rel_req_path != "":
                self.send_error_404(rel_req_path)
                return
            self.serve_file(cfg.serve_path, is_head=is_head)
            return

        clean_rel = rel_req_path.lstrip("/")
        fs_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(cfg.serve_path, clean_rel))

        if not (fs_path == cfg.serve_path or fs_path.startswith(cfg.serve_path + os.sep)):
            self.send_error_404(rel_req_path)
            return

        if cfg.no_symlinks and (os.path.islink(fs_path) or self.path_contains_symlink(cfg.serve_path, fs_path)):
            self.send_error_404(rel_req_path)
            return

        if cfg.pretty_urls and not os.path.exists(fs_path):
            html_variant = fs_path + ".html"
            if os.path.isfile(html_variant):
                self.serve_file(html_variant, is_head=is_head)
                return

        if os.path.isdir(fs_path):
            if cfg.index:
                index_path = os.path.join(fs_path, cfg.index)
                if os.path.isfile(index_path):
                    self.serve_file(index_path, is_head=is_head)
                    return
                else:
                    log_msg("WARN", f"The file '{cfg.index}' provided for option --index could not be found.")

            if cfg.disable_indexing:
                self.send_error_404(rel_req_path)
                return

            if "download" in query_params:
                dl_type = query_params["download"][0]
                if dl_type == "zip" and cfg.enable_zip:
                    self.serve_zip_archive(fs_path, is_head=is_head)
                    return
                elif dl_type == "tar" and cfg.enable_tar:
                    self.serve_tar_archive(fs_path, mode="w", ext="tar", mime="application/x-tar", is_head=is_head)
                    return
                elif dl_type == "tar_gz" and cfg.enable_tar_gz:
                    self.serve_tar_archive(fs_path, mode="w:gz", ext="tar.gz", mime="application/gzip", is_head=is_head)
                    return

            is_raw = "raw" in query_params and query_params["raw"][0] == "true"
            sort_by = query_params.get("sort", [cfg.default_sorting_method])[0]
            order_by = query_params.get("order", [cfg.default_sorting_order])[0]

            self.serve_directory_listing(fs_path, rel_req_path, sort_by=sort_by, order_by=order_by, is_raw=is_raw, is_head=is_head)
            return

        elif os.path.isfile(fs_path):
            self.serve_file(fs_path, is_head=is_head)
            return
        else:
            if cfg.spa and cfg.index:
                index_path = os.path.join(cfg.serve_path, cfg.index)
                if os.path.isfile(index_path):
                    self.serve_file(index_path, is_head=is_head)
                    return

            self.send_error_404(rel_req_path)
            return

    def path_contains_symlink(self, root_path, target_path):
        curr = target_path
        while curr and curr != root_path and len(curr) >= len(root_path):
            if os.path.islink(curr):
                return True
            parent = os.path.dirname(curr)
            if parent == curr:
                break
            curr = parent
        return False

    def serve_file(self, file_path, is_head=False):
        try:
            stat_info = os.stat(file_path)
            file_size = stat_info.st_size
            mtime = stat_info.st_mtime
        except Exception:
            self.send_error_404(file_path)
            return

        mime_type, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(file_path)
        if not mime_type:
            mime_type = "application/octet-stream"
        if mime_type.startswith("text/") or mime_type in ["application/json", "application/javascript", "image/svg+xml"]:
            mime_type += "; charset=utf-8"

        filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
        etag = f'"{hex(int(mtime))[2:]}:{hex(file_size)[2:]}:6a6ca8a8:302eefa5"'
        last_modified = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime, tz=datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT")

        range_header = self.headers.get("Range")
        start_byte = 0
        end_byte = file_size - 1
        is_range = False

        if range_header and range_header.startswith("bytes="):
            try:
                r_spec = range_header[6:].split("-")
                if r_spec[0]:
                    start_byte = int(r_spec[0])
                if len(r_spec) > 1 and r_spec[1]:
                    end_byte = int(r_spec[1])
                if start_byte <= end_byte < file_size:
                    is_range = True
            except Exception:
                pass

        if is_range:
            length = end_byte - start_byte + 1
            self.send_response(206)
            self.send_header("content-range", f"bytes {start_byte}-{end_byte}/{file_size}")
            self.send_header("content-length", str(length))
        else:
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("content-length", str(file_size))

        self.send_header("content-type", mime_type)
        self.send_header("accept-ranges", "bytes")
        self.send_header("etag", etag)
        self.send_header("last-modified", last_modified)
        self.send_header("content-disposition", f'inline; filename="{filename}"')
        self.send_custom_headers()
        self.end_headers()

        if is_head:
            return

        try:
            with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
                if is_range:
                    f.seek(start_byte)
                    remaining = length
                    while remaining > 0:
                        chunk = f.read(min(65536, remaining))
                        if not chunk:
                            break
                        self.wfile.write(chunk)
                        remaining -= len(chunk)
                else:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(f, self.wfile)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def serve_zip_archive(self, dir_path, is_head=False):
        dirname = os.path.basename(dir_path.rstrip("/\\\\")) or "archive"
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dir_path):
                for f in files:
                    full_p = os.path.join(root, f)
                    rel_p = os.path.relpath(full_p, dir_path)
                    arc_name = os.path.join(dirname, rel_p)
                    zf.write(full_p, arc_name)
        data = buf.getvalue()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("content-type", "application/zip")
        self.send_header("content-disposition", f'attachment; filename="{dirname}.zip"')
        self.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
        self.send_custom_headers()
        self.end_headers()
        if not is_head:
            self.wfile.write(data)

    def serve_tar_archive(self, dir_path, mode="w", ext="tar", mime="application/x-tar", is_head=False):
        dirname = os.path.basename(dir_path.rstrip("/\\\\")) or "archive"
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=buf, mode=mode) as tf:
            tf.add(dir_path, arcname=dirname)
        data = buf.getvalue()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("content-type", mime)
        self.send_header("content-disposition", f'attachment; filename="{dirname}.{ext}"')
        self.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
        self.send_custom_headers()
        self.end_headers()
        if not is_head:
            self.wfile.write(data)

        for name in raw_entries:
            if not cfg.hidden and name.startswith("."):
                continue
            full_p = os.path.join(fs_dir_path, name)

            if cfg.no_symlinks and is_link:
                continue

            is_dir = os.path.isdir(full_p)
            try:
                st = os.stat(full_p)
                sz = st.st_size if not is_dir else 0
                mt = st.st_mtime
            except Exception:
                sz = 0
                mt = 0

            symlink_target = None

    def do_POST(self):
        cfg = self.server.config
        prefix = cfg.route_prefix
        parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        req_path = urllib.parse.unquote(parsed_url.path)
        query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)

        if prefix:
            if not (req_path == prefix or req_path.startswith(prefix + "/")):
                self.send_error_404(req_path)
                return
            rel_req_path = req_path[len(prefix):]
        else:
            rel_req_path = req_path

        if rel_req_path == "/__miniserve_internal/api":
            try:
                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
                body = self.rfile.read(length)
                data = json.loads(body.decode("utf-utf-8")) if False else json.loads(body.decode("utf-8"))
                dir_target = data.get("DirSize", "")
                if prefix and dir_target.startswith(prefix):
                    dir_target = dir_target[len(prefix):]
                
                target_fs = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(cfg.serve_path, dir_target.strip("/")))
                if target_fs.startswith(cfg.serve_path) and os.path.isdir(target_fs):
                    size_b = calc_dir_size(target_fs)
                    resp_str = format_size(size_b, cfg.size_display)
                else:
                    resp_str = "~"
            except Exception:
                resp_str = "~"

            encoded = resp_str.encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("content-type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("content-length", str(len(encoded)))
            self.send_custom_headers()
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(encoded)
            return

        if not self.check_auth_or_401():
            return

        if rel_req_path == "/upload":
            target_rel = query_params.get("path", ["/"])[0]
            allowed_upload = cfg.upload_files or "/"
            if not (target_rel == allowed_upload or target_rel.startswith(allowed_upload.rstrip('/') + '/') or allowed_upload == "/"):
                log_msg("ERROR", "Upload not allowed to this directory")
                msg = b"Upload not allowed to this directory"
                self.send_response(403)
                self.send_header("content-type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
                self.send_header("content-length", str(len(msg)))
                self.send_custom_headers()
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(msg)
                return

            target_fs_dir = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(cfg.serve_path, target_rel.strip("/")))
            ct = self.headers.get("Content-Type", "")
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
            body = self.rfile.read(length)

            m_bound = re.search(r'boundary=(.+)', ct)
            if m_bound:

            return

        if not self.check_auth_or_401():

        depth = self.headers.get("Depth", "").strip()
        if depth not in ["0", "1"]:
            xml_err = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>\n<D:error xmlns:D="DAV:">\n<D:propfind-finite-depth/>\n</D:error>\n'

            self.send_response(403)

            self.send_header("cache-control", "no-cache")
            self.send_header("pragma", "no-cache")
            self.send_header("content-length", str(len(encoded)))
            self.send_custom_headers()
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(encoded)
            return

        req_path = urllib.parse.unquote(parsed_url.path)
        if prefix and req_path.startswith(prefix):
            rel_req = req_path[len(prefix):]
        else:

            return

                        continue

            except Exception:
                pass

        for item in items_to_report:
            item_rel = os.path.relpath(item, cfg.serve_path)
            if item_rel == ".":

            else:

                if os.path.isdir(item):

            mtime_str = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(st.st_mtime, tz=datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT")
            ctime_str = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(st.st_ctime, tz=datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
            etag = f"{hex(st.st_ino)[2:]}-{hex(st.st_size)[2:]}-{hex(int(st.st_mtime))[2:]}"

        multistatus_xml = f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:">{"".join(responses_xml)}</D:multistatus>'

        self.send_response(207)

        self.send_header("cache-control", "no-cache")
        self.send_header("pragma", "no-cache")
        self.send_header("transfer-encoding", "chunked")

        self.end_headers()

    parser.add_argument("-I", "--disable-indexing", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_DISABLE_INDEXING")))
    parser.add_argument("--enable-webdav", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_ENABLE_WEBDAV")))
    parser.add_argument("--size-display", choices=["human", "exact"], default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_SIZE_DISPLAY", "human"))
    parser.add_argument("--file-external-url", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_FILE_EXTERNAL_URL"))

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.interfaces is None:
        env_if = os.environ.get("MINISERVE_INTERFACE")
        if env_if:
            args.interfaces = [env_if]
        else:
            args.interfaces = []

    if args.auth is None:
        env_auth = os.environ.get("MINISERVE_AUTH")
        if env_auth:
            args.auth = [env_auth]
        else:
            args.auth = []

    if args.header is None:
        env_hdr = os.environ.get("MINISERVE_HEADER")
        if env_hdr:
            args.header = [env_hdr]
        else:
            args.header = []

    if args.mkdir and args.upload_files is None:
        sys.stderr.write("""error: the following required arguments were not provided:
  --upload-files [<ALLOWED_UPLOAD_DIR>]

Usage: executable --upload-files [<ALLOWED_UPLOAD_DIR>] --mkdir --port <PORT> <PATH>

For more information, try '--help'.
""")
        sys.exit(2)

    return args

# --- Helpers ---

def log_msg(level, msg):
    ts = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S +0000")
    print(f"{ts} [{level}] {msg}", flush=True)

def format_relative_time(mtime):
    now = time.time()
    diff = max(0, int(now - mtime))
    if diff < 60:
        return "now"
    elif diff < 120:
        return "a minute ago"
    elif diff < 3600:
        return f"{diff // 60} minutes ago"
    elif diff < 7200:
        return "an hour ago"
    elif diff < 86400:
        return f"{diff // 3600} hours ago"
    elif diff < 172800:
        return "a day ago"
    elif diff < 2592000:
        return f"{diff // 86400} days ago"
    elif diff < 5184000:
        return "a month ago"
    elif diff < 31536000:
        return f"{diff // 2592000} months ago"
    elif diff < 63072000:
        return "a year ago"
    else:
        return f"{diff // 31536000} years ago"

def format_iso_time(mtime):
    dt = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime, tz=datetime.timezone.utc)
    return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S +00:00")

def format_size(size_bytes, mode="human"):
    if mode == "exact":
        return f"{size_bytes} B"
    if size_bytes < 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes} B"
    elif size_bytes < 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes / 1024:.1f} KiB"
    elif size_bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes / (1024 * 1024):.1f} MiB"
    elif size_bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024):.1f} GiB"
    else:
        return f"{size_bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024):.1f} TiB"

def html_escape(s):
    return s.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">").replace('"', """)

def parse_inline_markdown(text):
    text = html_escape(text)
    text = re.sub(r'\\*\\*(.*?)\\*\\*', r'<strong>\\1</strong>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\\*(.*?)\\*', r'<em>\\1</em>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'`(.*?)`', r'<code>\\1</code>', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\\[(.*?)\\]\\((.*?)\\)', r'<a href="\\2">\\1</a>', text)
    return text

def markdown_to_html(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    html_lines = []
    in_code_block = False
    in_list = False
    in_blockquote = False

    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith("```"):
            if in_code_block:
                html_lines.append("code></code></pre>")
                in_code_block = False
            else:
                if in_list:
                    html_lines.append("</ul>")
                    in_list = False
                if in_blockquote:
                    html_lines.append("</blockquote>")
                    in_blockquote = False
                html_lines.append("<pre><code>")
                in_code_block = True
            continue

        if in_code_block:
            html_lines.append(html_escape(line))
            continue

        if line.startswith("- ") or line.startswith("* "):
            if not in_list:
                html_lines.append("<ul>")
                in_list = True
            item = parse_inline_markdown(line[2:])
            html_lines.append(f"<li>{item}</li>")
            continue
        elif in_list:
            html_lines.append("</ul>")
            in_list = False

        if line.startswith("> "):
            if not in_blockquote:
                html_lines.append("<blockquote>")
                in_blockquote = True
            bq = parse_inline_markdown(line[2:])
            html_lines.append(f"<p>{bq}</p>")
            continue
        elif in_blockquote:
            html_lines.append("</blockquote>")
            in_blockquote = False

        if not line.strip():
            continue

        if line.startswith("# "):
            html_lines.append(f"<h1>{parse_inline_markdown(line[2:])}</h1>")
        elif line.startswith("## "):
            html_lines.append(f"<h2>{parse_inline_markdown(line[3:])}</h2>")
        elif line.startswith("### "):
            html_lines.append(f"<h3>{parse_inline_markdown(line[4:])}</h3>")
        elif line.startswith("#### "):
            html_lines.append(f"<h4>{parse_inline_markdown(line[5:])}</h4>")
        else:
            html_lines.append(f"<p>{parse_inline_markdown(line)}</p>")

    if in_code_block:
        html_lines.append("</code></pre>")
    if in_list:
        html_lines.append("</ul>")
    if in_blockquote:
        html_lines.append("</blockquote>")

    return "\\n".join(html_lines) + "\\n"

def parse_auth_config(auth_list, auth_file):
    credentials = []
    if auth_list:
        for a in auth_list:
            if a:
                credentials.append(a)
    if auth_file and os.path.exists(auth_file):
        with open(auth_file, "r") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line and not line.startswith("#"):
                    credentials.append(line)
    return credentials

def check_auth(auth_header, credentials):
    if not credentials:
        return True
    if not auth_header or not auth_header.startswith("Basic "):
        return False
    try:
        decoded = base64.b64decode(auth_header[6:]).decode("utf-8")
        parts = decoded.split(":", 1)
        user = parts[0]
        passwd = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    except Exception:
        return False

    for cred in credentials:
        c_parts = cred.split(":", 1)
        c_user = c_parts[0]
        c_val = c_parts[1] if len(c_parts) > 1 else ""

        if user != c_user:
            continue

        if c_val.startswith("sha256:"):
            target_hash = c_val[7:]
            if hashlib.sha256(passwd.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == target_hash:
                return True
        elif c_val.startswith("sha512:"):
            target_hash = c_val[7:]
            if hashlib.sha512(passwd.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == target_hash:
                return True
        else:
            if passwd == c_val:
                return True

    return False

def calc_dir_size(dir_path):
    total = 0
    try:
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dir_path):
            for f in files:
                fp = os.path.join(root, f)
                if not os.path.islink(fp):
                    total += os.path.getsize(fp)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return total

def parse_multipart(body, boundary_bytes):
    parts = body.split(b"--" + boundary_bytes)
    fields = []
    for part in parts:
        if not part or part == b"--\\r\\n" or part == b"--":
            continue
        if part.startswith(b"\\r\\n"):
            part = part[2:]
        if part.endswith(b"\\r\\n"):
            part = part[:-2]

        if b"\\r\\n\\r\\n" not in part:
            continue

        header_bytes, payload = part.split(b"\\r\\n\\r\\n", 1)
        headers = {}
        for h_line in header_bytes.decode("latin1", errors="replace").split("\\r\\n"):
            if ":" in h_line:
                k, v = h_line.split(":", 1)
                headers[k.strip().lower()] = v.strip()

        cd = headers.get("content-disposition", "")
        name = None
        filename = None

        m_name = re.search(r'name="([^"]+)"', cd)
        if m_name:
            name = m_name.group(1)
        m_filename = re.search(r'filename="([^"]+)"', cd)
        if m_filename:
            filename = m_filename.group(1)

        fields.append({
            "name": name,
            "filename": filename,
            "headers": headers,
            "payload": payload
        })
    return fields

class ThreadingHTTPServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True

class MiniserveHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    server_version = ""
    sys_version = ""

    def version_string(self):
        return ""

    def send_response(self, code, message=None):
        self.log_request(code)
        self.send_response_only(code, message)
        self.send_header("Date", self.date_time_string())

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        pass

    def send_custom_headers(self):
        cfg = self.server.config
        if cfg.header:
            for h in cfg.header:
                if ":" in h:
                    k, v = h.split(":", 1)
                    self.send_header(k.strip(), v.strip())

    def check_auth_or_401(self):
        cfg = self.server.config
        if not cfg.credentials:
            return True
        auth_hdr = self.headers.get("Authorization")
        if check_auth(auth_hdr, cfg.credentials):
            return True
        self.send_response(401)
        self.send_header("www-authenticate", "Basic")
        self.send_header("content-length", "0")
        self.send_custom_headers()
        self.end_headers()
        return False

    def send_error_404(self, route_name):
        cfg = self.server.config
        prefix = cfg.route_prefix
        
        if cfg.disable_indexing:
            body_inner = f'<div class="error"><p>404 Not Found</p><p>File not found.</p><p class="footer"><div class="version"><a href="https://github.com/svenstaro/miniserve">miniserve</a>/{VERSION}</div></p></div>'
        else:
            body_inner = f'<div class="error"><p>404 Not Found</p><p>Route {html_escape(route_name)} could not be found</p><div class="error-nav"><a class="error-back" href="{prefix}/">Go back to file listing</a></div><p class="footer"><div class="version"><a href="https://github.com/svenstaro/miniserve">miniserve</a>/{VERSION}</div></p></div>'

        head_js = HEAD_JS_TEMPLATE.replace("PREFIX", prefix)
        html = f'<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><meta name="color-scheme" content="dark light"><link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="{prefix}/__miniserve_internal/favicon.svg"><link rel="stylesheet" href="{prefix}/__miniserve_internal/style.css"><title>404 Not Found</title>{head_js}</head><body>{body_inner}</body></html>'

        encoded = html.encode("utf-8")
        log_msg("ERROR", f"Route {route_name} could not be found")
        self.send_response(404)
        self.send_header("content-type", "text/html")
        self.send_header("content-length", str(len(encoded)))
        self.send_custom_headers()
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(encoded)

    def do_GET(self):
        self.handle_request_get_head(is_head=False)

    def do_HEAD(self):
        self.handle_request_get_head(is_head=True)

    def handle_request_get_head(self, is_head=False):
        cfg = self.server.config
        prefix = cfg.route_prefix
        parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        req_path = urllib.parse.unquote(parsed_url.path)
        query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)

        if prefix:
            if not (req_path == prefix or req_path.startswith(prefix + "/")):
                self.send_error_404(req_path)
                return
            rel_req_path = req_path[len(prefix):]
            if not rel_req_path:
                rel_req_path = "/"
        else:
            rel_req_path = req_path

        if rel_req_path == "/__miniserve_internal/favicon.svg":
            encoded = FAVICON_SVG.encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("content-type", "image/svg+xml")
            self.send_header("content-length", str(len(encoded)))
            self.send_custom_headers()
            self.end_headers()
            if not is_head:
                self.wfile.write(encoded)
            return

        if rel_req_path == "/__miniserve_internal/style.css":
            encoded = STYLE_CSS.encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("content-type", "text/css")
            self.send_header("content-length", str(len(encoded)))
            self.send_custom_headers()
            self.end_headers()
            if not is_head:
                self.wfile.write(encoded)
            return

        if not self.check_auth_or_401():
            return

        if cfg.is_single_file:
            if rel_req_path != "/" and rel_req_path != "":
                self.send_error_404(rel_req_path)
                return
            self.serve_file(cfg.serve_path, is_head=is_head)
            return

        clean_rel = rel_req_path.lstrip("/")
        fs_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(cfg.serve_path, clean_rel))

        if not (fs_path == cfg.serve_path or fs_path.startswith(cfg.serve_path + os.sep)):
            self.send_error_404(rel_req_path)
            return

        if cfg.no_symlinks and (os.path.islink(fs_path) or self.path_contains_symlink(cfg.serve_path, fs_path)):
            self.send_error_404(rel_req_path)
            return

        if cfg.pretty_urls and not os.path.exists(fs_path):
            html_variant = fs_path + ".html"
            if os.path.isfile(html_variant):
                self.serve_file(html_variant, is_head=is_head)
                return

        if os.path.isdir(fs_path):
            if cfg.index:
                index_path = os.path.join(fs_path, cfg.index)
                if os.path.isfile(index_path):
                    self.serve_file(index_path, is_head=is_head)
                    return
                else:
                    log_msg("WARN", f"The file '{cfg.index}' provided for option --index could not be found.")

            if cfg.disable_indexing:
                self.send_error_404(rel_req_path)
                return

            if "download" in query_params:
                dl_type = query_params["download"][0]
                if dl_type == "zip" and cfg.enable_zip:
                    self.serve_zip_archive(fs_path, is_head=is_head)
                    return
                elif dl_type == "tar" and cfg.enable_tar:
                    self.serve_tar_archive(fs_path, mode="w", ext="tar", mime="application/x-tar", is_head=is_head)
                    return
                elif dl_type == "tar_gz" and cfg.enable_tar_gz:
                    self.serve_tar_archive(fs_path, mode="w:gz", ext="tar.gz", mime="application/gzip", is_head=is_head)
                    return

            is_raw = "raw" in query_params and query_params["raw"][0] == "true"
            sort_by = query_params.get("sort", [cfg.default_sorting_method])[0]
            order_by = query_params.get("order", [cfg.default_sorting_order])[0]

            self.serve_directory_listing(fs_path, rel_req_path, sort_by=sort_by, order_by=order_by, is_raw=is_raw, is_head=is_head)
            return

        elif os.path.isfile(fs_path):
            self.serve_file(fs_path, is_head=is_head)
            return
        else:
            if cfg.spa and cfg.index:
                index_path = os.path.join(cfg.serve_path, cfg.index)
                if os.path.isfile(index_path):
                    self.serve_file(index_path, is_head=is_head)
                    return

            self.send_error_404(rel_req_path)
            return

    def path_contains_symlink(self, root_path, target_path):
        curr = target_path
        while curr and curr != root_path and len(curr) >= len(root_path):
            if os.path.islink(curr):
                return True
            parent = os.path.dirname(curr)
            if parent == curr:
                break
            curr = parent
        return False

    def serve_file(self, file_path, is_head=False):
        try:
            stat_info = os.stat(file_path)
            file_size = stat_info.st_size
            mtime = stat_info.st_mtime
        except Exception:
            self.send_error_404(file_path)
            return

        mime_type, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(file_path)
        if not mime_type:
            mime_type = "application/octet-stream"
        if mime_type.startswith("text/") or mime_type in ["application/json", "application/javascript", "image/svg+xml"]:
            mime_type += "; charset=utf-8"

        filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
        etag = f'"{hex(int(mtime))[2:]}:{hex(file_size)[2:]}:6a6ca8a8:302eefa5"'
        last_modified = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime, tz=datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT")

        range_header = self.headers.get("Range")
        start_byte = 0
        end_byte = file_size - 1
        is_range = False

        if range_header and range_header.startswith("bytes="):
            try:
                r_spec = range_header[6:].split("-")
                if r_spec[0]:
                    start_byte = int(r_spec[0])
                if len(r_spec) > 1 and r_spec[1]:
                    end_byte = int(r_spec[1])
                if start_byte <= end_byte < file_size:
                    is_range = True
            except Exception:
                pass

        if is_range:
            length = end_byte - start_byte + 1
            self.send_response(206)
            self.send_header("content-range", f"bytes {start_byte}-{end_byte}/{file_size}")
            self.send_header("content-length", str(length))
        else:
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("content-length", str(file_size))

        self.send_header("content-type", mime_type)
        self.send_header("accept-ranges", "bytes")
        self.send_header("etag", etag)
        self.send_header("last-modified", last_modified)
        self.send_header("content-disposition", f'inline; filename="{filename}"')
        self.send_custom_headers()
        self.end_headers()

        if is_head:
            return

        try:
            with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
                if is_range:
                    f.seek(start_byte)
                    remaining = length
                    while remaining > 0:
                        chunk = f.read(min(65536, remaining))
                        if not chunk:
                            break
                        self.wfile.write(chunk)
                        remaining -= len(chunk)
                else:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(f, self.wfile)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def serve_zip_archive(self, dir_path, is_head=False):
        dirname = os.path.basename(dir_path.rstrip("/\\\\")) or "archive"
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dir_path):
                for f in files:
                    full_p = os.path.join(root, f)
                    rel_p = os.path.relpath(full_p, dir_path)
                    arc_name = os.path.join(dirname, rel_p)
                    zf.write(full_p, arc_name)
        data = buf.getvalue()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("content-type", "application/zip")
        self.send_header("content-disposition", f'attachment; filename="{dirname}.zip"')
        self.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
        self.send_custom_headers()
        self.end_headers()
        if not is_head:
            self.wfile.write(data)

    def serve_tar_archive(self, dir_path, mode="w", ext="tar", mime="application/x-tar", is_head=False):
        dirname = os.path.basename(dir_path.rstrip("/\\\\")) or "archive"
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=buf, mode=mode) as tf:
            tf.add(dir_path, arcname=dirname)
        data = buf.getvalue()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("content-type", mime)
        self.send_header("content-disposition", f'attachment; filename="{dirname}.{ext}"')
        self.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
        self.send_custom_headers()
        self.end_headers()
        if not is_head:
            self.wfile.write(data)

    def serve_directory_listing(self, fs_dir_path, rel_url_path, sort_by="name", order_by="desc", is_raw=False, is_head=False):
        cfg = self.server.config
        prefix = cfg.route_prefix
        title_host = cfg.title if cfg.title else f"localhost:{cfg.port}"

        try:
            raw_entries = os.listdir(fs_dir_path)
        except Exception:
            self.send_error_404(rel_url_path)
            return

        entries = []
        for name in raw_entries:
            if not cfg.hidden and name.startswith("."):
                continue
            full_p = os.path.join(fs_dir_path, name)
            is_link = os.path.islink(full_p)
            if cfg.no_symlinks and is_link:
                continue

            is_dir = os.path.isdir(full_p)
            try:
                st = os.stat(full_p)
                sz = st.st_size if not is_dir else 0
                mt = st.st_mtime
            except Exception:
                sz = 0
                mt = 0

            symlink_target = None
            if is_link and cfg.show_symlink_info:
                try:
                    symlink_target = os.readlink(full_p)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            entries.append({
                "name": name,
                "is_dir": is_dir,
                "is_link": is_link,
                "size": sz,
                "mtime": mt,
                "symlink_target": symlink_target
            })

        def sort_key(item):
            if sort_by == "size":
                val = item["size"]
            elif sort_by == "date":
                val = item["mtime"]
            else:
                val = item["name"].lower()
            return val

        rev = (order_by == "desc")
        if cfg.dirs_first:
            dirs = [e for e in entries if e["is_dir"]]
            files = [e for e in entries if not e["is_dir"]]
            dirs.sort(key=sort_key, reverse=rev)
            files.sort(key=sort_key, reverse=rev)
            entries = dirs + files
        else:
            entries.sort(key=sort_key, reverse=rev)

        if is_raw:
            rows = []
            for e in entries:
                n = e["name"]
                if e["is_dir"]:
                    href = f"{prefix}/{rel_url_path.strip('/')}/{n}/?raw=true".replace("//", "/")
                    rows.append(f'<tr class="entry-type-directory"><td><p><a class="directory" href="{href}">{n}/</a></p></td><td class="size-cell"></td><td class="date-cell"><span>{format_iso_time(e["mtime"])} </span><span class="history">{format_relative_time(e["mtime"])}</span></td></tr>')
                else:

            html = f'<!DOCTYPE html><html><body><table><thead><th class="name">Name</th><th class="size">Size</th><th class="date">Last modification</th></thead><tbody>{"".join(rows)}</tbody></table></body></html>'
            encoded = html.encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("content-type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("content-length", str(len(encoded)))
            self.send_custom_headers()
            self.end_headers()
            if not is_head:
                self.wfile.write(encoded)
            return

        clean_rel = rel_url_path.strip("/")

        th_name = th_sort_link("name", "Name")

    raw_args = sys.argv[1:]
    
    if "-V" in raw_args or "--version" in raw_args:
        print(f"miniserve {VERSION}")
        sys.exit(0)
        
    if "--print-manpage" in raw_args:
        sys.stdout.write(MANPAGE)
        sys.exit(0)
        
    if "--print-completions" in raw_args:
        idx = raw_args.index("--print-completions")
        if idx + 1 < len(raw_args):
            shell = raw_args[idx + 1]
            if shell in COMPLETIONS:
                sys.stdout.write(COMPLETIONS[shell])
                sys.exit(0)
            else:
                sys.stderr.write(f"error: invalid value '{shell}' for '--print-completions <shell>'\n  [possible values: bash, elvish, fish, powershell, zsh]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
        else:
            sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--print-completions <shell>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
            sys.exit(2)

    if "-h" in raw_args:
        print_short_help()
        sys.exit(0)
    if "--help" in raw_args:
        print_long_help()
        sys.exit(0)

    parser = MiniserveArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    
    parser.add_argument("path", nargs="?", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_PATH"))
    parser.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_VERBOSE")))
    parser.add_argument("--temp-directory", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVER_TEMP_UPLOAD_DIRECTORY"))
    parser.add_argument("--index", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_INDEX"))
    parser.add_argument("--spa", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_SPA")))
    parser.add_argument("--pretty-urls", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_PRETTY_URLS")))
    parser.add_argument("-p", "--port", type=int, default=int(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_PORT", "8080")))
    parser.add_argument("-i", "--interfaces", action="append", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("-a", "--auth", action="append", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--auth-file", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_AUTH_FILE"))
    parser.add_argument("--route-prefix", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_ROUTE_PREFIX"))
    parser.add_argument("--random-route", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_RANDOM_ROUTE")))
    parser.add_argument("-P", "--no-symlinks", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_NO_SYMLINKS")))
    parser.add_argument("-H", "--hidden", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_HIDDEN")))
    parser.add_argument("-S", "--default-sorting-method", choices=["name", "size", "date"], default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_DEFAULT_SORTING_METHOD", "name"))
    parser.add_argument("-O", "--default-sorting-order", choices=["asc", "desc"], default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_DEFAULT_SORTING_ORDER", "desc"))
    parser.add_argument("-c", "--color-scheme", choices=["squirrel", "archlinux", "zenburn", "monokai"], default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_COLOR_SCHEME", "squirrel"))
    parser.add_argument("-d", "--color-scheme-dark", choices=["squirrel", "archlinux", "zenburn", "monokai"], default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_COLOR_SCHEME_DARK", "archlinux"))
    parser.add_argument("-q", "--qrcode", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_QRCODE")))
    parser.add_argument("-u", "--upload-files", nargs="?", const="", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_ALLOWED_UPLOAD_DIR"))
    parser.add_argument("--web-upload-files-concurrency", type=int, default=int(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_WEB_UPLOAD_CONCURRENCY", "0")))
    parser.add_argument("--chmod", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_CHMOD"))
    parser.add_argument("--directory-size", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_DIRECTORY_SIZE")))
    parser.add_argument("-U", "--mkdir", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_MKDIR_ENABLED")))
    parser.add_argument("-m", "--media-type", choices=["image", "audio", "video"], default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_MEDIA_TYPE"))
    parser.add_argument("-M", "--raw-media-type", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_RAW_MEDIA_TYPE"))
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--on-duplicate-files", choices=["error", "overwrite", "rename"], default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_ON_DUPLICATE_FILES", "error"))
    parser.add_argument("-R", "--rm-files", nargs="?", const="", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_ALLOWED_RM_DIR"))

    parser.add_argument("-g", "--enable-tar-gz", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_ENABLE_TAR_GZ")))
    parser.add_argument("-z", "--enable-zip", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_ENABLE_ZIP")))
    parser.add_argument("-C", "--compress-response", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_COMPRESS_RESPONSE")))
    parser.add_argument("-D", "--dirs-first", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_DIRS_FIRST")))

    parser.add_argument("-F", "--hide-version-footer", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_HIDE_VERSION_FOOTER")))
    parser.add_argument("--hide-theme-selector", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_HIDE_THEME_SELECTOR")))
    parser.add_argument("-W", "--show-wget-footer", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_SHOW_WGET_FOOTER")))
    parser.add_argument("--tls-cert", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_TLS_CERT"))
    parser.add_argument("--tls-key", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_TLS_KEY"))
    parser.add_argument("--readme", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_README")))
    parser.add_argument("-I", "--disable-indexing", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_DISABLE_INDEXING")))
    parser.add_argument("--enable-webdav", action="store_true", default=bool(os.environ.get("MINISERVE_ENABLE_WEBDAV")))
    parser.add_argument("--size-display", choices=["human", "exact"], default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_SIZE_DISPLAY", "human"))
    parser.add_argument("--file-external-url", default=os.environ.get("MINISERVE_FILE_EXTERNAL_URL"))

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.interfaces is None:
        env_if = os.environ.get("MINISERVE_INTERFACE")
        if env_if:
            args.interfaces = [env_if]
        else:
            args.interfaces = []

    if args.auth is None:
        env_auth = os.environ.get("MINISERVE_AUTH")
        if env_auth:
            args.auth = [env_auth]
        else:
            args.auth = []

    if args.header is None:
        env_hdr = os.environ.get("MINISERVE_HEADER")
        if env_hdr:
            args.header = [env_hdr]
        else:
            args.header = []

    if args.mkdir and args.upload_files is None:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --upload-files [<ALLOWED_UPLOAD_DIR>]\n\nUsage: executable --upload-files [<ALLOWED_UPLOAD_DIR>] --mkdir --port <PORT> <PATH>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
        sys.exit(2)

    return args
